INSERT INTO requests (tmdb_id, media_type, imdb_id, title, year, poster_path, note,
                                 infuse_pro, status, requested_by, created_at, status_changed_at)
           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'pending', ?, ?, ?)
           ON CONFLICT (tmdb_id, media_type, infuse_pro) DO NOTHING
           RETURNING id AS "id!"
